ModMetaData.name: Jawa Plant Growth (local)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Planetary fast growth. One Harmony postfix on Verse.Plant.GrowthRate multiplies the composite growth rate of every plant from every mod, so nothing has to be enumerated and any plant a mod adds later is caught automatically.
Three bands, biome-aware: - wild plants and crops x4.0 - trees x2.5 (wood stays a decision) - plants on a terminator / poison-forest biome x0.4 (the one place on this world where growth has stalled)
Every number, the terminator biome roster and the exempt plant list live in Defs/JawaPlantGrowthSettings.xml and are read at startup, so tuning does not need a rebuild. The compiled defaults in RimMandrake.Utinni.PlantGrowth.PlantGrowthConfig are used only if that def is missing.
Exempt plants are untouched in every biome: the anima tree and the Gauranlen tree (their slowness is ritual and dryad pacing, not botany), ambrosia (deliberately scarce), and any plant whose growDays is already under 1 day.
The postfix scales the COMPOSITE GrowthRate rather than a single GrowthRateFactor_*, so environmental penalties (light, temperature, fertility, drought) still apply and the terminator case genuinely comes out slower than vanilla.
Load after Harmony. It is silent when it works: verify from the inspect string on a plant, which reads the boosted rate because it is computed from the same getter.
